description: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/identity.rs line 19, thread.rs line 20, vacation.rs line 31: use 'args["ids"].take()' to extract and consume a field. All other handlers (mailbox.rs, submission.rs, email.rs, all chat-server handlers) use 'args.remove("ids")' or 'args.get("ids")'. The take() pattern on an index operator is non-idiomatic: Value::Index panics on non-objects (unlike get), and .take() leaves a null behind. args.remove("ids") is the correct ownership-consuming idiom for Value::Object. This inconsistency creates different panic profiles across similar code paths.
title: identity.rs handle_identity_get: args["ids"].take() vs args.get pattern used elsewhere
